source.publication: 2025 IT-140 Personal Income Tax Forms and Instructions (West Virginia Tax Division), with Schedule M bound in
source.section: Schedule M line 33(a)-(b) Other Retirement Modification, 'Combined amounts of 33a and 33b must not exceed $2,000' (PDF p.5; instructions PDF p.28; PDF p.22); IT-140 lines 1-8 (PDF p.3; instructions PDF p.26: exemptions 2,000 each, line 7 floored at zero); Rate Schedules I and II (PDF p.37); Tax Table (PDF p.38 on)

worked: Married filing jointly, 60 and 62: your West Virginia PERS pension 10,000 (capped at 2,000 in Column A) and your spouse's federal pension 1,000 (Column B, its own 2,000); the cap is per person. You (Column A) born 1965-04-04, age 60 at December 31, 2025; Spouse (Column B) born 1963-08-08, age 62 at December 31, 2025. Federal AGI (given) = wages 50,000.00 (you) + West Virginia PERS/Teachers' pension 10,000.00 (you) + federal civil service pension 1,000.00 (spouse) = 61,000.00. Federal taxable income (given, not tested) = 61,000.00 - standard deduction 31,500.00 = 29,500.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). IT-140 line 1 federal AGI 61,000.00. Schedule M additions lines 51-58 none; IT-140 line 2 0.00. Schedule M You (Column A): line 33(a) WV Teachers'/PERS 2,000.00, line 33(b) federal retirement 0.00; line 33 = lesser of their sum 2,000.00 and 2,000.00 = 2,000.00; line 47: age 60, under 65 and not disabled, none; line 49 = 2,000.00. Schedule M Spouse (Column B): line 33(a) WV Teachers'/PERS 0.00, line 33(b) federal retirement 1,000.00; line 33 = lesser of their sum 1,000.00 and 2,000.00 = 1,000.00; line 47: age 62, under 65 and not disabled, none; line 49 = 1,000.00. Line 50 total subtractions = 2,000.00 + 1,000.00 = 3,000.00. IT-140 line 3 subtractions 3,000.00; line 4 West Virginia AGI = 61,000.00 + 0.00 - 3,000.00 = 58,000.00. Line 5 Low-Income Earned Income Exclusion: federal AGI over 10,000, none. Line 6 exemptions 2 x 2,000.00 = 4,000.00. Line 7 taxable income = 58,000.00 - 4,000.00 = 54,000.00. Line 8 tax by Rate Schedule I (PDF p.37) bands: 2.22% x 10,000.00 = 222 + 2.96% x 15,000.00 = 444 + 3.33% x 15,000.00 = 499.5 + 4.44% x 14,000.00 = 621.6; total 1787.1 = 1,787.10. The Tax Table row 54,000 to under 54,050 (PDF p.38 on) gives 1,788; expected keeps the schedule formula on the exact income. No Family Tax Credit (Modified Federal AGI above the table limits); credits 0.00; state income tax 1,787.10.
accepted_approximations: Tax below 100,000 of taxable income is figured on the exact income, where the booklet uses a Tax Table row's midpoint rounded to the whole dollar. Other tax is also rounded to the whole dollar in the booklet.
